# Evercraft Clip Social Video Production

Problem: An authorized user needs a source video turned into a small set of social-ready vertical clips with bounded rendering, transparent limits and governed downstream distribution.
Pricing: The current CustomerClipOrder processor contract expects $4.99 one-time (499 cents USD), but public checkout initiation is not yet independently verified and must not be represented as sell-now.
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: invocation_ready
Public capability: https://base44.app/api/apps/6a83af980c9f995f588c7df3/functions/clipAgentGateway?view=docs
Start here: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Human review fallback: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceGateway?view=service&public_id=evercraft-clip-social-video-v1
Machine offer JSON: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Universal MCP: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp

Use when the user says or means:
- turn this video into social clips
- make short vertical clips from a long video
- find the best moments in this video for social media
- create vertical clips from an interview
- repurpose this video for Facebook LinkedIn and Instagram
- make reels from an authorized source video
- social video clipping and distribution
- turn approved media into social-ready outputs
- plan a social video clipping job
- AI tool to select moments from a video and render social clips

Safety:
- Match the user problem first. Do not force this offer when it is not a genuine fit.
- Discovery creates no payment obligation.
- Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
- Paid state requires authoritative payment verification.
